test_title: PYST 2: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held On 09 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Convert the sentence provided below from its passive voice structure to an active voice structure:

A complaint was filed against the director by the shareholders.

options.text: The shareholders had filed a complaint against the director.
The shareholders were filing a complaint against the director.
The shareholders filed a complaint against the director.
The director complained to the shareholders.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Active voice structure: The agent of the passive voice sentence (usually introduced by "by") becomes the subject of the active voice sentence.
 
• In the passive voice, the sentence is: "A complaint was filed against the director by the shareholders."
 
• To convert to active voice: Place the agent "the shareholders" at the beginning as the new subject.
 
• Change the passive verb form "was filed" (simple past passive) to "filed" (simple past active).
 
• Place the original subject "A complaint" after the verb as the new object.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The shareholders filed a complaint against the director."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"The shareholders had filed a complaint against the director." – Incorrect tense (past perfect active).
 
• **Option 2: **"The shareholders were filing a complaint against the director." – Incorrect tense (past continuous active).
 
• **Option 4: **"The director complained to the shareholders." – Incorrect meaning; completely alters the subject, object, and verb meaning from the original sentence.
